candidates.name: ray-vex-threeoperand
candidates.legality: Each VEX scalar operation has the original arithmetic operand order and inherits the same upper128 bits from the original MOVAPS source. Upper YMM bits become zero; the complete generated assembly has no YMM uses. Requires observed AVX+OSXSAVE support and dead upper lanes. No reassociation.
candidates.expectedEffect: Fusing necessary two-address copies may reduce backend work; mixed AVX/SSE transition costs may erase benefit.
candidates.scope: Host-specific generated-code diagnostic, not portable compiler equivalence; ISA fallback required.
candidates.hotnessKind: Historical Phase194 nearest-owner proxy; NOT current or block weight

candidates.name: ray-ordered-compare
candidates.legality: Ordered a<b equals ordered b>a, including signed-zero equality and unordered NaNs. SETA rejects unordered because CF/ZF are set. SETNP is retained to preserve r11b. The following CMP and final TEST overwrite flags before control use. UCOMISS invalid-exception conditions are symmetric.
candidates.expectedEffect: Remove the Boolean AND dependency while retaining result stores and subsequent normalization.
candidates.scope: Exact local low128/register/flag-live equivalence, including unordered outcomes.
candidates.hotnessKind: Historical Phase194 nearest-owner proxy; NOT current or block weight

candidates.name: ray-boolean-chain
candidates.legality: SETB/SETNP/AND/MOVZX establishes full r10 in {0,1}; comparing this Boolean to1 is identity. Both original stores remain. Final TEST overwrites flags before the original JZ.
candidates.expectedEffect: Remove three serial integer operations following the floating predicate; amount may be small relative to FP latency.
candidates.scope: Exact local Boolean identity; no integer-minimum or decrement changes.
candidates.hotnessKind: Historical Phase194 nearest-owner proxy; NOT current or block weight

candidates.name: ray-exact-threshold-inputs
candidates.legality: 1 and1000 are exactly representable binary32 under every rounding mode. Replace only integer conversions with their exact bit patterns; final r10/xmm0/xmm2/xmm3 and zero upper128 lanes match. DIVSS remains, preserving rounding, inexact and exception behavior of1/1000.
candidates.expectedEffect: Remove exact conversion chains before a long-latency DIVSS; threshold arithmetic, not the previously tested zero conversion.
candidates.scope: Exact input conversion; no reciprocal constant folding or fast math.
candidates.hotnessKind: Historical Phase194 nearest-owner proxy; NOT current or block weight

candidates.name: ray-early-radius-square
candidates.legality: Move the independent radius square earlier using dead xmm8; original xmm1 and xmm3 values are restored at their use point. No operand association changes. Requires masked FP exceptions and ordinary input scope; possible unmasked trap ordering is NOT generally equivalent. Extra memory read is the same valid immutable private slot.
candidates.expectedEffect: Overlap radius multiply with dot/distance computation despite one extra instruction; may rank below count-only edits.
candidates.scope: Speculative schedule diagnostic only under masked exceptions; not general equivalence.
candidates.hotnessKind: Historical Phase194 nearest-owner proxy; NOT current or block weight

candidates.name: ray-discriminant-register
candidates.legality: Keep discriminant in dead xmm8 across its retained frame store and zero-constant sequence, replacing only the reload. All upper128 lanes of this arithmetic chain are zero from MOVD origins, so MOVAPS equals the old zero-extending MOVD. No call, unknown alias or write to xmm8 intervenes.
candidates.expectedEffect: Avoid one store/reload dependency with an added copy; MCA lacks store-forwarding realism and may misrank it.
candidates.scope: Exact local full128 equivalence from zero-upper provenance; original memory side effect retained.
candidates.hotnessKind: Historical Phase194 nearest-owner proxy; NOT current or block weight

exclusion: No Phase196 minimum, decrement, zero-conversion, memory-operand folding or redundant-copy edit is repeated.
